How to find us

  • By car
    Client parking behind the building, entrance via Hauensteinstraße. From Switzerland: border crossing Stein–Bad Säckingen.
  • By train and bus
    Bad Säckingen station, 7 minutes on foot; direct trains from Basel Badischer Bahnhof
  • On foot from the old town
    From Münsterplatz via Schützenstraße, about 5 minutes
